title: Terribly Optimized
description: This pack is absolutely terrible. It will completely ruin your cinematic 15 FPS slideshow experience by forcing your game to run like your on a $4,000 pc. Side effects may include: chunks loading instantly, lack of stutters, and your PC fan not ramping up.
body:
Terribly Optimized is an ultra-lightweight performance modpack built specifically for low-end computers, budget laptops, and systems struggling to maintain a playable framerate in vanilla Minecraft. By replacing the game's default engine logic with highly efficient alternatives, the pack dramatically increases frames per second, reduces system memory allocation, and eliminates the frequent micro-stutters that ruin gameplay on weaker hardware.

Instead of adding heavy content or altering the core vanilla experience, Terribly Optimized focuses entirely on hidden background systems. The game will visually look and play identically to normal Minecraft, but it runs with a fraction of the hardware strain.

When tested, fps increased by 200fps.
## Testing Conditions
CPU: i5-8365u
ALLOCATED RAM: 8GB DDR4-2400
GPU: RTX 3080 TI FOUNDERS EDITION
